verdict.rationale: Ollama is a model runtime and launcher. The evidence shows it powering external agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw) and serving a REST API, but nothing documents Ollama itself letting users set up background automations, triggers or recurring schedules. OpenClaw's assistant and the developer API are an integration and building blocks, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
